[{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Technical Tutorial: Eat That Frog - Tackling High-Resistance Tasks in Time Management"},{"order":2,"type":"subheading","text":"Introduction"},{"order":3,"type":"paragraph","text":"In software development and engineering management, decision fatigue and procrastination are major bottlenecks. Inspired by Brian Tracy's productivity methodology, the "Eat That Frog" technique focuses on identifying your most challenging, high-resistance task (the frog) and executing it first thing in the work day."},{"order":4,"type":"subheading","text":"Core Principles of the Frog Methodology"},{"order":5,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Identify the biggest, most important task with the highest psychological resistance."},{"order":6,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Execute this task immediately during peak cognitive hours without getting bogged down by minor administrative emails or trivial tickets."},{"order":7,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Build compounding momentum for the rest of the engineering sprint."},{"order":8,"type":"subheading","text":"Automating Frog Identification via Scripting"},{"order":9,"type":"paragraph","text":"To systematically apply this to your daily developer workflow, you can write a small Python script to parse your backlog or daily task list, prompting you to select and lock in your primary objective."},{"order":10,"type":"code","text":"import json

def select_frog(task_list):
    print("--- DAILY FROG IDENTIFIER ---")
    for idx, task in enumerate(task_list):
        print(f"{idx + 1}. {task['title']} (Impact: {task['impact']}, Effort: {task['effort']})")
    
    choice = int(input("Select your primary frog for today (number): "))
    selected_frog = task_list[choice - 1]
    
    print(f"\nLocked in! Your frog is: \"{selected_frog['title']\"}")
    print("Rule: Do not open Slack or email until this is completed.")

# Example execution
tasks = [
    {"title": "Refactor legacy authentication middleware", "impact": "High", "effort": "High"},
    {"title": "Update dependency lockfiles", "impact": "Low", "effort": "Low"},
    {"title": "Write unit tests for payment gateway", "impact": "High", "effort": "Medium"}
]

# select_frog(tasks)"},{"order":11,"type":"subheading","text":"Best Practices for Implementation"},{"order":12,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Pre-planning: Always select your frog the evening before so your subconscious can process the logic overnight."},{"order":13,"type":"bullet_point","text":"Zero Distractions: Block notifications, close IDE extensions that trigger alerts, and isolate yourself until the primary task reaches a pull-request stage."},{"order":14,"type":"paragraph","text":"By consistently tackling high-resistance tasks first, you reduce daily cognitive load and dramatically accelerate project delivery timelines."}]
